findings.entity: Colored balls inside the glass bowl
findings.description: During stirring, the initially smooth spherical balls develop irregular shapes. At 00:07.750 the red ball near the back rim appears blocky and flattened; by 00:09.750 the front green ball has a pronounced indentation and lobed outline, and the right red ball is similarly misshapen. These localized contour changes are inconsistent with the original rigid spheres and exceed simple directional motion blur.
